note: ICVCM Core Carbon Principles (CCP) decisions at methodology level, compiled by hand from the cited public sources. This is not an assessment of individual projects.

statuses.approved_with_conditions: ICVCM approved the methodology (or these versions) for the CCP label; project-level conditions apply.
statuses.not_approved: ICVCM assessed the methodology and decided it does not meet the CCPs.
statuses.not_ccp_approved: The methodology has no CCP approval (not assessed or superseded); a successor methodology may be approved.
statuses.unknown: No ICVCM decision recorded in this table.

methodologies.summary: In August 2024 ICVCM rejected current grid-connected renewable energy methodologies because their additionality tests were insufficiently rigorous.

ICVCM approved ACM0001 versions 15-19 for landfill gas projects, subject to additional criteria (including limits on electricity generation). Earlier versions are not eligible. Verra's successor VMR0016 was approved in August 2026.

Verra excluded its older REDD+ methodologies (including VM0007) from ICVCM assessment; their credits cannot carry the CCP label. ICVCM approved the successor VM0048 v1.0 with conditions in November 2024.
No CCP approval for VMR0006. ICVCM approved Verra's successor cookstove methodology VM0050 v1.0 with conditions that constrain fNRB and require stricter fuel-use monitoring.
